name: entwurf
description: Turn a project into buildable specifications, one expert role at a time. Guided interviews for the three people a project needs: the product owner (goals, scope, vocabulary, then feature specifications), the technical architect (constraints, then the architecture baseline), and the experience lead (conditions of use, states, components, content). Output is a standard GitHub Spec Kit specs/ folder ready to hand to a development team, or to Fabrik. The product-owner path needs no terminal, git, or technical background.
